agentId.description: Optional: the agent or conversation it came from.

confidence.description: [0, 1]. Omit to use the server default.

episodeId.description: Only for an existing episode (correction, import); never guess it. Normally send sessionId.

idempotencyKey.description: Retry key: a resend returns the first result.

kind.description: 'fact' (default), 'decision', 'episode', 'entity', 'strategy', 'workflow', 'skill', 'task', 'event' or 'reasoning'; unknown returns 400. Category goes in subtype.

scope.description: Default 'global'. 'personal' = your personal workspace, across projects; needs a user-bound key (mns_live_ keys fail: 'scope personal requires a user-bound key').

scopeRef.description: Project ref (e.g. 'mnemosyne'), filterable at recall; entity names and aliases are canonicalized (warnings scope_ref_canonicalized, scope_ref_unrecognized).

sessionId.description: The session id returned by memory_episode_start (or 'Episode: open'). Always pass it: memory_episode_end links its facts to the episode; without it, no origin context ever.

statement.description: One self-contained claim (e.g. 'Client Acme prefers communication in Spanish.').

subject.description: What the fact is about (e.g. 'acme', 'user:dana@example.com'). Default 'workspace'.

subtype.description: fact: 'preference' | 'trait' | 'event' | 'relationship' | 'skill' | 'concern' | 'architecture' | 'bugfix' | 'config' | 'discovery' | 'policy' | 'process' | 'other' (default). A choice with rationale is a decision: use memory_decide. Other kinds: see memory_decide, memory_entity. Unknown values fall back, with a warning.

targetWorkspaceId.description: Write to this workspace UUID instead (needs write/admin; IDs: memory_context).

topicKey.description: An active fact or decision with this key is updated, not duplicated (e.g. 'auth-strategy'). See memory_suggest_topic_key.
